content.short: Crypto/fiat wallet with card and stablecoin usage.
content.description: Belo, founded in 2021 in Buenos Aires, is a Latin American digital wallet that lets more than three million users hold local currencies alongside digital dollars and crypto. Within a single app, people can buy, hold, send, and receive BTC, ETH, SOL, and stablecoins such as USDC and USDT across supported networks including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, and Solana, then spend balances through a linked card. Backed by a Tether-led funding round, Belo leans on stablecoin infrastructure to offer cross-border transfers, foreign exchange, and everyday payments at lower cost than traditional banks. Its goal is to give people in Latin America's inflation-prone economies a simple way to protect savings in dollars and move money without borders.
content.meta: Belo is a LatAm wallet for holding dollars, crypto, and stablecoins with a spending card. Discover Belo and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
